title: Metric dimension of complete-base supertoken graphs
source: E. T. Baskoro, C. Dalfó, M. A. Fiol and R. Simanjuntak, On some metric properties of supertoken graphs, Utilitas Mathematica 123 (2025), 19–33; Conjecture 4.2. https://doi.org/10.61091/um123-02
source_paper_text: For integers n≥1 and k≥1, let X={x∈Z_{≥0}^n:sum_i x_i=k}. The k-supertoken graph F_k(K_n) has vertex set X; two vectors are adjacent when one unit is moved from one coordinate to a different coordinate. Its distance is d(x,y)=(1/2)sum_i|x_i−y_i|. A resolving set R⊆X distinguishes all distinct x,y∈X: some r∈R has d(x,r)≠d(y,r). Its minimum cardinality is the metric dimension, with dimension zero for the one-vertex graph. The conjecture asserts dim(F_k(K_n))=n−1 for all n,k in this domain. The source proves the upper bound n−1 using concentrated-token vertices; its counting bound proves equality whenever k^(n−2)+n−2 < binomial(n+k−1,k) for n≥2.
target: Determine whether the stated conjecture is true, prioritizing an explicit exact counterexample. Certify the full hypotheses and failure of the conclusion. A complete verified proof also settles the assertion, but report PROVED rather than REFUTED. Failure to find a witness in a bounded search is partial progress only.
